name: Crunchy persimmon
summary: Crunchy persimmon from the Mimosa Pass and Cau Dat orchards, sweet and aromatic, the fruit people buy as a gift.
origin: Hồng giòn, the crisp persimmon visitors buy as a gift because it is sweet and aromatic.
taste: Freshly picked fruit is sweet and juicy.
howToEat: Eat it fresh, or carry it home.
The drying season is about late October to November; crunchy fruit runs from September through December.
where: Orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, and roads around the Cau Dat tea hills.
